text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't I do pretty well in that practice run earlier?
Against Ramonu-senpai, no less!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, how so...?
She completely overpowered me with her technique."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Relying on sheer technique on impulse—
how unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's lacking, isn't it?
—My physical body, that is.

After training, I accompanied Mejiro Ramonu to a cafe after she said she needed to nourish her body.
A massive spread of food is laid out before her.
choice_data_list: Are you really going to eat all that?
Are you really going to eat that much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it's lacking, just increase it.
—Simple, right?

Increase food intake to prioritize bulking up, and raise training load on top of that to achieve the ideal physique.
—That seems to be her plan.
choice_data_list: Still, isn't this way too much no matter how you look at it...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes, there is no such thing as a safe love.
choice_data_list: Let's rework the plan. Keep your meals properly portioned.
Let's prioritize your physical strength and eat plenty!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Saying that implies
you must have an alternative plan in mind, yes?
I had some materials I'd hastily put together back when she was worried about her physical shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Balancing both physical prowess and skill...
...A more balanced—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Tell me the details.
choice_data_list: It's a bit of a long story to explain, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If so, that works out perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Could you please portion out this dish?
—For two people, please.

Listening to the new training plan,
Mejiro Ramonu ate a measured meal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Mercilessly building, carving,
and polishing one's physique—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: After all, this body is a vessel for pouring in the love I dedicate to racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I intend to make it even more beautiful,
without leaving behind a single flaw.
Mejiro Ramonu finished every single dish from the massive spread she had prepared.
